hazards.name: Adverse Environmental Temperature
hazards.risk: Possibility of over exposure to extreme heat / cold
hazards.control: Operatives to wear suitable PPE, check all materials, tools and plant equipment prior to use and ensure that adequate breaks are taken.

hazards.name: Asbestos
hazards.control: Operatives will check the demolition / refurbishment survey prior to commencing works, and will not touch or disturb any part of any identified Asbestos. Our engineers have undertaken an Asbestos Awareness course.

hazards.name: Changes In Floor Levels
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings and use handrails whilst using stairs

hazards.name: Cold / Hot Surfaces
hazards.control: Operatives to wear safety gloves / suitable PPE

hazards.name: Confined Spaces
hazards.control: Confined space supervisor to devise safe working system. Possible emergency rescue equipment to be readily available. No lone working

hazards.name: COSHH / Chemicals / Hazardous Substances
hazards.risk: Inhalation of fumes / contact with skin
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure the corresponding COSHH Assessment, MSDS and PPE are available and read prior to using the substance

hazards.name: Dropped Objects
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to property
hazards.control: Install an exclusion zone below the working area

hazards.name: Dust
hazards.control: Dampen down the area to act as dust suppression. Installation of forced exhaust / ventilation. Correct RPE to be utilised

hazards.name: Electricity
hazards.control: All engineers to have proven competence and work to 18th Edition standards. Correct isolation and locking off procedures to be followed (Bulletin 78, LOTOTO etc). NO LIVE WORKING.

hazards.name: Entanglement / Crush & Pinch Points
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure guarding is in place and the equipment is correctly isolated and locked off

hazards.name: Extreme Hot / Cold Liquids
hazards.control: Operatives to wear suitable PPE / cover all bare skin areas

hazards.name: Falls On Same Level, Slips & Trips
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings and where necessary provide warning signage

hazards.name: Flammable Materials / Substances
hazards.control: Operatives to remove or cover the associated materials / substances if undertaking hot works. Fire extinguishers to be available and serviced

hazards.name: Flying Particles
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to property
hazards.control: Operatives to wear correct PPE and where possible cover the surrounding area

hazards.name: Gas
hazards.control: All existing services to be completely isolated before work commences.

hazards.name: Hazardous Waste / WEEE
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to environment
hazards.control: Correct spill kits and PPE to be utilised. Redundant materials to be recycled correctly

hazards.name: Heat / Hot Works
hazards.control: Engineers to clear or cover the area and apply for all permits prior to start of works. Fire extinguishers to be available and serviced

hazards.name: High Winds
hazards.control: All works to be suspended in winds exceeding 28mph / 12.5m/s

hazards.name: Impact / Crushing
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure guarding is in place and the equipment is correctly isolated and locked off

hazards.name: Inadequate Ventilation
hazards.control: Forced ventilation and gas monitors to be installed. Possible emergency rescue equipment to be available

hazards.name: Lifting Operations
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / property from falling materials
hazards.control: Only competent persons to undertake any lifting tasks. Clearly mark out & barrier off working area.

hazards.name: Liquid Fuels
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to environment
hazards.control: COSHH details to be gained prior to use. Correct spill kits, drip trays and PPE to be utilised.

hazards.name: Liquid Spills
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to environment
hazards.control: Spill kits to be utilised and disposed of correctly

hazards.name: Live Cables
hazards.control: Correct isolation and locking off procedures to be followed and undertaken prior to works commencing. NO LIVE WORKING.

hazards.name: Lone Working
hazards.risk: No one else in attendance if emergency occurs
hazards.control: Operatives to devise a clear method of communication during works. Operatives to make contact at regular intervals and discuss working schedule.

hazards.name: Manual Handling
hazards.control: Mechanical aids to be utilised, where possible. Task, Individual, Load & Environment (T.I.L.E) procedures to be followed.

hazards.name: Mobile Plant / Vehicles / Equipment
hazards.risk: Bodily injury from collision with site plant
hazards.control: Barrier off working area. Inform chargehand of activities that are due to take place. Correct levels of PPE protection.

hazards.name: No Kickboards
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / property from falling materials
hazards.control: Clearly mark out & barrier off working area. Install an exclusion zone below the working area

hazards.name: Noise / Vibration
hazards.risk: Long term hearing damage. Possible white finger
hazards.control: Operatives to wear suitable ear protection / PPE and where possible use remotely controlled plant / equipment / tools

hazards.name: Non-Hazardous Waste
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to environment
hazards.control: Redundant materials to be recycled correctly

hazards.name: Open Blade Knife
hazards.control: Close blade and remove from work area when not in use. Utilise alternative cutting tools or pre-cut / manufactured materials

hazards.name: Open Edges Not Adequately Protected / No Handrails
hazards.control: Temporary handrails to be installed or fall resist protection worn

hazards.name: Openings / Holes Not Identified Or Protected
hazards.control: Cover holes with temporary coverings or barrier off the surrounding area

hazards.name: Other Workers / Sub-Contractors
hazards.control: Co-ordination of all works to be undertaken

hazards.name: Overhead Services
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings and where necessary correctly isolate the services

hazards.name: Pesticides
hazards.risk: Ingestion of hazardous substance / contact with skin
hazards.control: Operatives to wear appropriate gloves and wash hands after all tasks. Operatives to ensure the corresponding COSHH Assessment, MSDS and PPE are available and adhered to

hazards.name: Poor Ergonomics
hazards.risk: Strains from repetitive, bending, stooping & kneeling
hazards.control: Operatives to avoid repetitive / sustained working, take regular breaks and use knee pads or kneeling mats where appropriate

hazards.name: Poor Housekeeping
hazards.control: Ensure the correct routing of extension leads and the correct storage of materials and tools

hazards.name: Poor Light / Visibility
hazards.control: Adequate temporary lighting to be in place whilst working

hazards.name: Protruding Objects
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to property
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings, if possible, remove the object, or where necessary provide warning signage

hazards.name: Residue In "Empty" Tanks Or Containers
hazards.control: All containers to be correctly labelled, secured and where necessary, the contents disposed of correctly

hazards.name: Restricted Access & Egress
hazards.control: Emergency evacuation procedures to be devised prior to works commencing. Possible emergency rescue equipment to be readily available. No lone working

hazards.name: Road Traffic
hazards.control: Operatives to remain within the designated pedestrian walkways and wear hi-visibility clothing

hazards.name: Sharp Edges On Materials
hazards.control: Operatives to wear gloves or use mechanical aids

hazards.name: Site Vehicles / Plant
hazards.control: Operatives to remain within the designated pedestrian walkways and wear hi-visibility clothing

hazards.name: Slippery Surfaces
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings. If possible, cover the floor with non slip material. Use correct levels of PPE protection

hazards.name: Snow / Ice / Mud / Water
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings. If possible, cover the floor with non slip material. Use correct levels of PPE protection

hazards.name: Solvents
hazards.risk: Ingestion of hazardous substance / contact with skin
hazards.control: Operatives to wear appropriate gloves and wash hands after all tasks. Operatives to ensure the corresponding COSHH Assessment, MSDS and PPE are available and adhered to

hazards.name: Steam
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings. Use correct levels of PPE protection / cover all bare skin areas

hazards.name: Stored Energy - Release Of Pneumatic / Hydraulic Energy
hazards.risk: Unintentional / Un-controlled release, injury to persons
hazards.control: Trained and competent personnel. Systems drained / de-pressurised and isolated prior to work commencing.

hazards.name: Stored Energy - Release Of Potential Energy
hazards.control: Correct isolation and locking off procedures to be followed (Bulletin 78, LOTOTO etc)

hazards.name: Surfaces Not Capable Of Supporting A Load
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to property
hazards.control: No works to be undertaken without sufficient supporting temporary platforms being in place.

hazards.name: Toxic Contaminants
hazards.risk: Ingestion of hazardous substance / contact with skin
hazards.control: Operatives to wear appropriate gloves and wash hands after all tasks. Operatives to ensure the corresponding COSHH Assessment, MSDS and PPE are available and adhered to

hazards.name: Unguarded Machinery
hazards.control: Avoid any unnecessary work in close proximity to unguarded moving machinery

hazards.name: Unserviceable Electrical Tools
hazards.control: Calibration certification will be checked prior to use. All damaged / faulty equipment will be removed from service until replaced or repaired. All Electrical Tools Are PAT Tested

hazards.name: Unserviceable Lifting Accessories
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to property
hazards.control: A visual inspection will occur before any operation takes place. All damaged / faulty equipment will be removed from service until replaced or repaired

hazards.name: Unserviceable Tools
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / Damage to property
hazards.control: A visual inspection will occur before any operation takes place. All damaged / faulty equipment will be removed from service until replaced or repaired

hazards.name: Vapours / Fumes
hazards.risk: Inhalation of fumes / contact with skin
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure the corresponding COSHH Assessment, MSDS and PPE are available and adhered to. Use correct levels of PPE protection / cover all bare skin areas

hazards.name: WAH - Falling From Height
hazards.risk: Injury due to falling / incorrect operation.
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings. A visual inspection of any equipment to be utilised will occur before any operation takes place. Rescue plans to be devised and discussed prior to works

hazards.name: WAH - Fixed Scaffolding
hazards.risk: Injury due to falling / incorrect operation.
hazards.control: A visual inspection of the equipment will occur before any operation takes place. All operators are competent / trained. Operatives to ensure Scafftags are utilised and in date

hazards.name: WAH - Ladders
hazards.risk: Injury due to falling / incorrect operation.
hazards.control: Visual inspections of ladders will occur before any works occur. Operatives will ensure the area is clear before positioning the ladder. Maintain three points of contact. The ladder will be used for access purposes only.

hazards.name: WAH - MEWP’s
hazards.risk: Injury due to falling / incorrect operation.
hazards.control: A visual inspection of the equipment will occur before any operation takes place. All operators are IPAF trained.

hazards.name: WAH - Mobile Scaffold Tower
hazards.risk: Injury due to falling / incorrect operation.
hazards.control: A visual inspection of the equipment will occur before any operation takes place. All operators are PASMA trained.

hazards.name: WAH - Podiums
hazards.risk: Injury due to falling / incorrect operation.
hazards.control: Visual inspections of equipment will occur before any works occur. Operatives will ensure the area is clear from debris / slippery surfaces before using the podiums.

hazards.name: WAH - Stepladders
hazards.risk: Injury due to falling / incorrect operation.
hazards.control: Visual inspections of equipment will occur before any works occur. Operatives will ensure the area is clear from debris / slippery surfaces before using the steps. The steps will be used for un-sustained low level working.

hazards.name: Water
hazards.risk: Floor and area can become slippery when wet
hazards.control: Operatives to ensure they are aware of their surroundings. If possible, cover the floor with non slip material, if there is a chance of spills. Use correct levels of PPE protection

hazards.name: Weather
hazards.control: All works to be suspended in high winds and correct levels of PPE will be utilised. If possible, cover the floor with non slip material, if there mud / water ands leaves present.

hazards.name: Welding
hazards.control: Engineers to clear or cover the area and apply for all permits prior to start of works. Fire extinguishers to be available and serviced

hazards.name: Workers Out Of View / Distance Between Workers
hazards.risk: Lack of communication if emergency occurs
hazards.control: Operatives to devise a clear method of communication during works. Operatives to make contact at regular intervals and discuss working schedule.

hazards.name: Working Over A Handrail
hazards.risk: Injury to persons / damage to property
hazards.control: Install an exclusion zone below the works. Operatives to wear a full body safety harness c/w fall resist lanyard attached to a suitable anchor point prior to works. Tools to be tethered to handrail.

hazards.name: Working Over A Void
hazards.control: Install temporary boarding / covers over the void. Operatives to wear a full body safety harness c/w fall resist lanyard attached to a suitable anchor point prior to works. Tools to be tethered.

hazards.name: Working Over The Top Of Others
hazards.control: Install an exclusion zone below the works. No persons to enter the exclusion zone whilst operatives are working above unless protective sheeting / netting is installed.

hazards.name: Working Under Others
hazards.control: Co-ordination of all works to be undertaken. Protective sheeting / netting to be installed prior to works

requirements.name: Working Off A Ladder / Stepladders / Podium
Use Of Hand Tools / Spanners / Pipe Wrench
